note: Alpha ladder of the Qwen3.5-9B generation policy (writes K prompts) trained with GRPO against Stable Diffusion 3.5 Large, training update 900. Rung N serves that LoRA adapter at scale N/100 (0 to 2); the slider covers 0 to 1 in steps of 0.05 and the alpha box goes up to 2. Adapters: neulab/t-dig/sd35-large/9b-generate (the released checkpoint there is update 950, chosen by the rule in its README; the ladder the paper's interactive study served used update 900). Build the rungs with scripts/build_alpha_ladders.sh.
